raw_segments.text: But what if there had been a circumcision of such natures in the days of their youth,
and they had been severed from those sensual pleasures, such as eating and drinking, which,
like leaden weights, were attached to them at their birth, and which dragged them down
and turned the vision of their souls upon the things that are below?
